prompt: A developer plans to propose a fix to an open source project. One step in the plan will not produce a pull request. Click the broken line.
explanation: "Use this template" stamps out a brand-new repository — it opens nothing and stays unlinked. Pull requests are opened from your pushed branch toward the upstream repository.
codeLines: Create a branch for the fix
Commit and push the branch to the fork
Click "Use this template" to generate the pull request
